summary.goal: Implement the BullMQ job queue system with 6 queues powering all async work in cultivate. poll-sources (concurrency 3, retry 3 exponential) calls adapter.poll(), performs exact dedup, and fans out one process-signal job per matching Greenhouse. process-signal (concurrency 5, retry 2) runs the full pipeline. ingest-document (concurrency 2, retry 1) chunks documents then enqueues N process-signal jobs. recluster runs weekly (Sun 03:00 UTC). decay runs daily (04:00 UTC). trend-detect runs hourly. All queues have dead letter handling with diagnostic context.

acceptance_criteria.description: poll-sources queue: concurrency 3, retry 3 with exponential backoff, calls adapter.poll() and performs exact dedup (source_type + external_id)
poll-sources worker fans out one process-signal job per matching Greenhouse for each raw event
process-signal queue: concurrency 5, retry 2, executes the full pipeline (Tier 0 → Tier 1 → Tier 2 → Tier 3 → Score → Cluster → Store → SSE)
ingest-document queue: concurrency 2, retry 1, chunks documents then enqueues N process-signal jobs (one per chunk)
recluster scheduled job runs weekly on Sunday at 03:00 UTC
decay scheduled job runs daily at 04:00 UTC
trend-detect scheduled job runs hourly
All 6 queues have dead letter handling that captures diagnostic context (job data, error message, stack trace, attempt count)

steps.title: Add bullmq and ioredis dependencies
steps.description: Add bullmq and ioredis as dependencies to packages/cultivate/package.json. Create src/jobs/index.ts as the module entry point. Define shared queue configuration types: QueueName enum, QueueConfig interface with concurrency, retries, backoff strategy, and cron schedule fields.

acceptance_criteria.description: bullmq and ioredis are listed in package.json dependencies
QueueName enum defines all 6 queue names
QueueConfig interface supports concurrency, retry, backoff, and cron fields

steps.title: Implement queue creation with concurrency/retry configs
steps.description: Create src/jobs/queues.ts. Implement createQueues(redisConnection) that creates all 6 BullMQ queues with their specific configurations: poll-sources (concurrency 3, retry 3, exponential backoff), process-signal (concurrency 5, retry 2), ingest-document (concurrency 2, retry 1), recluster (weekly Sun 03:00 UTC), decay (daily 04:00 UTC), trend-detect (hourly). Each queue shares the Redis connection. Export a CultivateQueues object containing all queue instances.

acceptance_criteria.description: All 6 queues are created with correct concurrency and retry settings
Scheduled queues (recluster, decay, trend-detect) have correct cron expressions
All queues share the provided Redis connection

steps.title: Implement poll-sources worker (adapter poll + fan-out)
steps.description: Create src/jobs/workers/poll-sources.ts. The worker calls adapter.poll() for the specified source config, performs exact dedup by checking source_type + external_id against storage, then determines which Greenhouses match the source. For each matching Greenhouse, enqueue one process-signal job with the normalized event and greenhouse_id. Handle adapter errors by updating source health (consecutive_failures counter, health status transitions per escalation policy).

acceptance_criteria.description: Worker calls adapter.poll() and receives raw events
Exact dedup skips events already seen (source_type + external_id)
Per-Greenhouse fan-out: one process-signal job per matching Greenhouse
Source health updated on failure according to escalation policy

steps.title: Implement process-signal worker (pipeline execution)
steps.description: Create src/jobs/workers/process-signal.ts. The worker receives a normalized event + greenhouse_id, then runs the full pipeline: Tier 0 greenhouse gate → Tier 1 rule registry → Tier 2 ML classification → Tier 3 LLM extraction → scoring → clustering → storage → SSE broadcast. On filter rejection at any tier, record provenance and exit without error. On pipeline errors, throw to trigger BullMQ retry.

acceptance_criteria.description: Worker executes full pipeline in correct order
Filtered signals exit gracefully with provenance recorded
Pipeline errors trigger BullMQ retry mechanism

steps.title: Implement ingest-document worker (chunking + enqueue)
steps.description: Create src/jobs/workers/ingest-document.ts. The worker receives an ingestion job (filename, greenhouse_id), chunks the document using recursive splitting (with speaker-aware splitting for interview transcripts), updates IngestionJob status and progress (total_chunks, processed_chunks), then enqueues one process-signal job per chunk. Emit ingestion:progress SSE events during chunking and ingestion:complete when done.

acceptance_criteria.description: Documents are chunked using recursive splitting strategy
Interview transcripts use speaker-aware chunking
Each chunk becomes a separate process-signal job
SSE events emitted for ingestion progress and completion

steps.title: Implement scheduled jobs (decay/recluster/trend-detect)
steps.description: Create src/jobs/workers/scheduled.ts. Implement three scheduled job processors: decay worker calls the decay engine for all greenhouses, recluster worker triggers Sonnet-based cluster review (merge/split/rename) per greenhouse, trend-detect worker runs hourly velocity calculation and emits cluster:trending SSE on transitions. Each scheduled worker processes all active greenhouses in sequence.

acceptance_criteria.description: Decay worker processes all greenhouses at daily 04:00 UTC
Recluster worker runs Sonnet review at weekly Sun 03:00 UTC
Trend-detect worker runs hourly and emits SSE on trend transitions

steps.title: Add dead letter handling with diagnostic context
steps.description: Create src/jobs/dead-letter.ts. Configure BullMQ dead letter handling for all 6 queues. When a job exhausts retries, move it to a dead letter state with full diagnostic context: original job data, error message, stack trace, attempt count, queue name, timestamps. Implement functions to list dead letter jobs, replay individual jobs (re-enqueue to original queue), replay all, and discard. These functions are consumed by the API layer.

acceptance_criteria.description: Failed jobs beyond retry limit are captured with full diagnostic context
Dead letter jobs can be listed with pagination
Individual dead letter jobs can be replayed to their original queue
Bulk replay-all and discard operations are supported
